record.title: Geometric Arveson–Douglas conjecture
record.statement:
Let $V$ be a homogeneous variety in $\mathbb{C}^{d}$, and let
$$
\mathcal{M}=\{f\in H^{2}_{d}: f(z)=0\text{ for all }z\in V\cap\mathbb{B}^{d}\}.
$$
If $S_{j}=P_{\mathcal{M}^{\perp}}M_{z_{j}}|_{\mathcal{M}^{\perp}}$ for $j=1,\ldots,d$, then
$$
[S_{j},S_{k}^{*}]\in\mathcal{S}^{q}\qquad (j,k=1,\ldots,d)
$$
for every $q>\dim_{\mathbb{C}}V$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12979), page 44. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Carleson measures for Besov–Sobolev spaces in the difficult range
record.statement:
Characterize the positive Borel measures \(\mu\) on the unit ball \(B_2^d\subset\mathbb C^d\) for which
\[
\int_{B_2^d}|f(z)|^2\,d\mu(z)\le C(\mu)\,\|f\|_{B_2^\sigma(B_2^d)}^2\qquad\text{for every }f\in B_2^\sigma(B_2^d),
\]
in the range \(\tfrac12<\sigma<\tfrac d2\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12979), page 60. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finiteness of simple even lattices of signature $(2,n)$
record.statement: For every integer $n\ge 1$, there exist only finitely many isomorphism classes of even simple lattices $L$ of signature $(2,n)$. Here $L$ is simple when the space $S_{1+n/2,L'/L}$ of cusp forms of weight $1+n/2$ for the Weil representation associated with its discriminant form $L'/L$ is zero.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/22](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12980), page 48. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Exact complexity of the lens spaces $L(n,1)$
record.statement: It was conjectured that $c(L(n,1))=n-3$ for every integer $n>3$, where $c(L(n,1))$ denotes the (pseudo-simplicial) complexity of the lens space $L(n,1)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12984), page 12. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Li–Roberts conjecture on taut-foliation slopes
record.statement: For every non-trivial knot $K\subset S^3$, the interval of slopes $( -a,b)$, with $a,b>0$, for which the exterior of $K$ admits a co-orientable taut foliation meeting the boundary in the foliation by circles of slope $\alpha$ should always contain $( -1,1)$.

record.title: Analyticity of the singularity formation set for the Kähler–Ricci flow
record.statement: The singularity formation set $\Sigma$ is an analytic subvariety of $X$. The report states that this decade-old conjecture of Feldman–Ilmanen–Knopf (2003) was proved by Valentino Tosatti.

record.title: A generalization of Gromov’s almost flat manifold theorem
record.statement:
For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and every $D<\infty$, there exists $\varepsilon=\varepsilon(n,D)>0$ such that if $(M,g)$ is a Riemannian $n$-dimensional manifold satisfying
\[
\operatorname{diam}_g(M)\le D,\qquad K_g\ge -1,\qquad \fint_M\|\operatorname{Rm}\|_g\,d\mu_g\le\varepsilon,
\]
then $M$ is finitely covered by a nilmanifold.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/29](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12987), page 43. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Cyclicity conjecture for Jacobians of Erdős–Rényi random graphs
record.statement:
For any fixed $0<q<1$, the probability that the Jacobian of the Erdős–Rényi random graph $G(n,q)$ is cyclic tends, as $n$ tends to infinity, to
\[
\zeta(3)^{-1}\zeta(5)^{-1}\zeta(7)^{-1}\zeta(9)^{-1}\cdots,
\]
which is roughly $0.7935$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/31](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13101), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Conjecture 0.14 for Hilbert schemes of K3 surfaces
record.statement:
Let $S$ be a K3 surface and let $X=S^{[m]}$ be the $m$-th Hilbert scheme of $S$. With the decomposition
$$
CH^i(X)\simeq\bigoplus_j CH^i_{(j)}(X),\qquad CH^i_{(j)}(X):=CH^i\bigl(h^{2i-j}(X)\bigr),
$$
Conjecture 0.14 asserts that
$$
CH^i_{(j)}(X)=0\quad\text{for }j<0.
$$
Moreover, the cycle class map
$$
cl:CH^i_{(0)}(X)\longrightarrow H^{2i}(X)
$$
is injective.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/31](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13101), page 36. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Dimension of the base of the maximal rationally connected fibration
record.statement: **Conjecture 3.** The maximal rationally connected fibration of $\widetilde{\mathcal M}^{4}_{15,16}$ has a three-dimensional base.

record.title: Existence and uniqueness of fractional Lawson cones
record.statement:
For every $m,n\ge 1$ and $0<s<1$, there exists a unique $\alpha=\alpha(s,m,n)>0$ such that the Lawson cone
\[
C_\alpha=\{(u,v)\in\mathbb{R}^m\times\mathbb{R}^n:\ |v|=\alpha|u|\}
\]
is an $s$-fractional minimal surface in $\mathbb{R}^{m+n}\setminus\{0\}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/33](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13103), page 32. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Dimension-free, ball-independent bounds for maximal operators associated with convex bodies
record.statement: Prove the general case: for every $p>1$, the centered Hardy–Littlewood maximal operators associated with balls in $\mathbb{R}^d$ have strong-type $(p,p)$ bounds whose constants are independent of both the dimension $d$ and the particular balls used.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13104), page 5. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Dimension-free weak type $(1,1)$ bounds for the centered maximal operator over Euclidean balls
record.statement:
Let $M_d$ be the centered Hardy–Littlewood maximal operator over Euclidean balls in $\\mathbb{R}^d$ with Lebesgue measure, and let $c_{1,d}$ be the optimal constant in the weak type $(1,1)$ inequality
$$
\alpha\,\bigl|\{x\in\mathbb{R}^d:M_df(x)\ge\alpha\}\bigr|\le c_{1,d}\,\|f\|_{L^1(\mathbb{R}^d)}
$$
for all $\alpha>0$ and $f\in L^1(\mathbb{R}^d)$. Is $\sup_{d\ge1}c_{1,d}<\infty$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13104), page 6. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Euclidean-type spectral multiplier theorem for arbitrary stratified groups
record.statement:
For an arbitrary stratified Lie group $G$ of topological dimension $d$, a homogeneous sublaplacian $L$ on $G$, and a Borel function $F:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{C}$ satisfying
\[
\sup_{t>0}\|F(t\,\cdot)\chi\|_{W^s_2}<\infty
\]
for some $s>d/2$, does it follow that $F(L)$ is of weak type $(1,1)$ and bounded on $L^p(G)$ for every $1<p<\infty$? Here $\chi\in C_c^\infty((0,\infty))$ is a nonzero cutoff.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13104), page 31. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uniform lower bounds for Bergman kernels of Kähler–Ricci solitons
record.statement:
Let $n$ and $F$ be positive numbers, and let $\mathrm{KR}(n,F)$ be the space of compact $n$-dimensional Kähler–Ricci solitons $(X,\omega)$ with $\mathrm{Fut}(X,\omega)\le F$. Then there exist a positive integer $k$ and a constant $a>0$, depending only on $n$ and $F$, such that
\[
\inf_{\mathrm{KR}(n,F)}\rho_k(z)\ge a
\]
for all $z\in X$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13104), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Main conjecture for Vinogradov’s Mean Value Theorem
record.statement:
For all integers $r,d\ge 1$ and every $\varepsilon>0$, let $J_{r,d}(X)$ be the number of solutions in integers $1\le x_1,\ldots,x_{2r}\le X$ to
\[
x_1^m+\cdots+x_r^m=x_{r+1}^m+\cdots+x_{2r}^m\qquad(1\le m\le d).
\]
Then
\[
J_{r,d}(X)\ll_{r,d,\varepsilon}X^{\varepsilon}\bigl(X^r+X^{2r-D}\bigr),\qquad D=\frac{d(d+1)}2.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13104), page 43. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Instability of all nontrivial Ricci solitons
record.statement: Does the instability property—namely, that the second variation operator \(\nu''\) admits a positive eigenvalue—hold for all nontrivial Ricci solitons?

record.title: Lemmermeyer’s GI-extension conjecture for finite 2-groups
record.statement: Every finite $2$-group $H$ embeds as a subgroup of index $2$ in a group $G$ generated by involutions outside $H$ (equivalently, $H$ has a GI-extension).

record.title: Bounded Height Conjecture in Hyperbolic 3-manifolds
record.statement: **Conjecture 2.** Let $M$ be a $k$-cusped hyperbolic $3$-manifold. Then the height of any Dehn filling of $M$ is uniformly bounded.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/38](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13108), page 28. Canonicalized from 5 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Probable Proposition 2 on a two-sheeted orbifold cover
record.statement:
Let $O=\mathbb{H}^3/\Gamma$ be an orientable hyperbolic $3$-orbifold. Suppose that every finite subgroup of $\Gamma$ is cyclic. Then $O$ has a two-sheeted orbifold cover $O'$ such that the underlying manifold $N'$ of $O'$ satisfies
\[
\dim H_1(N';\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})\geq \dim H_1(O;\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})+1.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/38](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13108), page 54. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Beauville–Voisin conjecture for projective hyper-Kähler manifolds
record.statement: For every projective hyper-Kähler manifold $X$, the cycle class map from the Chow ring to cohomology is injective on the subalgebra generated by the first Chern classes of line bundles on $X$ and the Chern classes of $X$ (equivalently, of $T_X$).

For a compact Kähler manifold $X$, is $\dim_{\mathbb C} H^0(X,mK_X)$ unchanged under holomorphic deformations of $X$ for every integer $m
a0 2$?

record.title: Geometric permutations of non-overlapping congruent balls
record.statement: Conjecture: For every $n\ge 4$, $n$ congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with pairwise disjoint interiors admit at most two geometric permutations.

record.statement: For every integer $d\ge 2$ and every integer $r\ge 2$ that is not a prime power, let $N=(r-1)(d+1)$. For every continuous map $f:\Delta_N\to\mathbb{R}^d$, do there exist points $x_1,\ldots,x_r\in\Delta_N$ lying in pairwise vertex-disjoint faces $\sigma_1,\ldots,\sigma_r$ of $\Delta_N$ such that $f(x_1)=\cdots=f(x_r)$?

record.title: Einstein solvmanifolds are maximally symmetric
record.statement: If a solvable Lie group admits a left-invariant Einstein metric $g$ of negative Ricci curvature, then $g$ is maximally symmetric: for every other left-invariant Riemannian metric $h$ on the group, the isometry group of $h$ is contained in the isometry group of $\[4m\Phi^*g\u001b[0m$ for some automorphism $\[4m\Phi\[0m$ of the group.

record.title: Commensurated subgroups of finite-index subgroups of $SL_3(\mathbb{Z})$

record.title: Total blow-up along a valuation

record.title: Characterization of diophantine henselian valuation rings by the residue field
record.statement: Let $F$ be a field. An equicharacteristic henselian valuation ring with residue field $F$ is diophantine if and only if, for every $F_1,F_2\equiv F$ and every non-trivial valuation $v$ on $F_1$, the residue field of $v$ cannot be embedded into $F_2$.

record.title: Behavior of Boolean functions on Ford trees
record.statement: For the Ford (\-model) random tree of size $n$, label each internal node independently and uniformly from $\{\wedge,\vee\}$ and each leaf independently and uniformly from $\{x_1,\bar{x}_1,\ldots,x_k,\bar{x}_k\}$. What is the limiting behavior, as $n\to\infty$, of the law of the Boolean function computed by the resulting and/or tree?

record.title: Normalizations at non-regular-singular LP/N endpoints
record.statement:
Formulate satisfactory normalizations of the fundamental system $\{\varphi,\psi\}$ near endpoints of LP/N type that are not regular singular points; for example, Lennard–Jones potentials near $x=0$:

record.title: Miura-like origami tessellations approximating arbitrary intrinsically curved surfaces

record.title: Wilson’s conjecture on double-Ising interfaces

record.title: Equivariant localization preserving commutative ring spectra
record.statement: Let $G$ be a finite group, let $L_E$ denote localization with respect to an equivariant spectrum $E$, and call a spectrum $Z$ $E$-acyclic if $E\wedge Z$ is contractible. If, for every $E$-acyclic $Z$ and every subgroup $H\subseteq G$, the norm $N_H^G Z$ is $E$-acyclic, then for every equivariant commutative ring spectrum $R$, $L_E(R)$ is an equivariant commutative ring spectrum.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2015/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13499), page 17. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rational injectivity for Whitehead groups under centralizer homology finiteness
record.statement:
Let $G$ be a group. Assume that, for every finite cyclic subgroup $C\subseteq G$, the abelian groups $H_1(BZ_GC;\mathbb Z)$ and $H_2(BZ_GC;\mathbb Z)$ are finitely generated. Then the map
\[
\varinjlim_{H\subseteq G,\,|H|<\infty}\operatorname{Wh}(H)\otimes_{\mathbb Z}\mathbb Q\;\longrightarrow\;\operatorname{Wh}(G)\otimes_{\mathbb Z}\mathbb Q
\]
is injective.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2015/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13499), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Descent in algebraic K-theory for finite Galois extensions
record.statement:
Assume that $G$ is a finite group and that $A\to B$ is a $G$-Galois extension in the sense of Rognes satisfying
\[
1\in\operatorname{im}\bigl(K_0(B)\otimes\mathbb{Q}\to K_0(A)\otimes\mathbb{Q}\bigr).
\]
Then the canonical map of K-theory spectra
\[
K(A)\longrightarrow K(B)^{hG}
\]
is an $L_n$-equivalence for all primes and all $n\ge 0$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2015/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13499), page 28. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Relative Cartier criterion
record.statement: Let $C$ be a smooth curve and $f:X\to C$ a proper, flat family of normal varieties of dimension $n$. Let $D$ be a Weil divisor on $X$ such that its restriction $D_c$ is an ample Cartier divisor for every $c\in C$. Then: (1) the function $c\mapsto (D_c^n)$ is upper semicontinuous on $C$; and (2) $D$ is a Cartier divisor on $X$ if and only if this function is constant.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2015/15](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13500), page 8. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Stable irrationality of very general complex hypersurfaces

record.title: Tannakian duality for unitary modular tensor categories
record.statement: **Conjecture (Tannakian duality for UMTCs).** Let $N$ be a type III factor and let $\mathcal{C}\subset\operatorname{End}(N)$ be a full and replete unitary modular tensor category. Every such $\mathcal{C}$ comes from a conformal net. Equivalently, for every UMTC $\mathcal{C}$ there is a conformal net $A$ such that $\operatorname{Rep}(A)\cong\mathcal{C}$.

record.title: Anderson’s infinite-dimensional paving conjecture
record.statement:
For every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists $r\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, for every self-adjoint $H\in B(\ell^2)$ with zero diagonal, there exists a partition $\{A_1,\ldots,A_r\}$ of $\mathbb{N}$ such that
\[
\|P_{A_i}HP_{A_i}\|\leq \varepsilon\,\|H\|\qquad\text{for every }i\in\{1,\ldots,r\},
\]
where $P_{A_i}:\ell^2\to\ell^2$ is the orthogonal projection onto the coordinates indexed by $A_i$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2015/17](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13674), page 10. Canonicalized from 12 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: McKay conjecture for the prime 2

record.title: Bertram’s conjecture on the number of conjugacy classes

record.title: Conjectured sharp bounds for the order of a finite group from its Brauer character degrees
record.statement: Let $p$ be a prime and let $G$ be a finite group with $O_p(G)=1$. If $\beta(1)_p\le p$ for all $\beta\in\operatorname{IBr}_p(G)$, then the bounds in Theorem 5 should be sharpenable as follows: (i) if $p=2$, then $|G|_2\le 2^7$; (ii) if $p\ge 5$ or if $p=3$ and $A_7$ is not involved in $G$, then $|G|_p\le p^2$; (iii) if $p=3$ and $A_7$ is involved in $G$, then $|G|_3\le 3^3$.

record.title: Exponential prime torsion in Schubert varieties for \(\mathrm{SL}_N\)
record.statement:
Let \(p\)-torsion in a variety \(X\) mean \(p\)-torsion in a stalk or costalk of the intersection cohomology complex \(IC(X;\mathbb Z)\). There exists a constant \(c>1\) such that, for all sufficiently large \(N\), the set
\[
\{p>c^N\mid p\text{ is prime and there exists \(p\)-torsion in a Schubert variety in }\mathrm{SL}_N\}
\]
is nonempty.

record.title: Rosenberg’s conjecture on quasidiagonality of amenable group C*-algebras
record.statement: For every countable discrete group $G$, if $G$ is amenable, then its reduced group C*-algebra $C^*_{\lambda}(G)$ is quasidiagonal.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2015/29](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13686), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: K-theory Novikov conjecture
record.statement:
For every discrete group $G$, the assembly map
\[
H^G_*(E(G,\{1\}),K(\mathbb{Z}))\otimes\mathbb{Q}\longrightarrow K_*(\mathbb{Z}[G])\otimes\mathbb{Q}
\]
is injective.
